correctness.rationale: For every real signal use exact coarea reduction to binary cuts. On a cut the operator gives differences alpha*d-(1-alpha)*(U-V)/(pq). The sharp integer inequality U>=pq/max(p,q) for U>V and the exhaustive two absolute-value regimes give the claimed upper envelope. A whole-part cut and a singleton in a larger part achieve both branches, giving exactness and the unique parameter optimum. The independent Fraction checker confirms direct graph computations in 31,468 exhaustive small binary cases and other exact tests. No finite enumeration is used as an all-size proof.
